integrity.claims: No independence or third-party mathematical certification is asserted.
integrity.proof: Complete deduction with cited published input theorems and exact multiplicity argument.
integrity.reproducibility: A standalone finite verification program is embedded; finite verification is not an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: Uses Yudin (2026) exceptional-endpoint theorem and Tao/Yudin uniform short-parameter bounds as published inputs.
Exact high-precision evaluation of the infinite correction constant is not claimed.
Uniform upper bound two holds for consecutive-largest triples only; other individual endpoints may have additional nonconsecutive triples.
Possible earlier implicit combination of classical squarefree-part observations and the 2026 endpoint theorem is an originality risk.
title: The missing multiplicity constant in square products of three factorials
